subject: Private Offer: Oakridge Labs - commission split & non-standard term request
messages:
From: Priya Shah <pshah@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer: Oakridge Labs - commission adjustment request

Hi Vanessa,

Following up from the marketplace onboarding call earlier this week — Oakridge Labs is ready to move to a private offer on AWS Marketplace, but finance pushed back on the standard 20% marketplace commission. They are requesting a split of 12% to AWS and 88% to Redwood for the first 12 months to mirror an existing distributor arrangement.

Attached is a draft private offer worksheet from AWS that highlights the requested split (AWS_PO_Draft_RevShare.xlsx). High level:
- Estimated first-year ARR booked through the offer: $150,000 ARR
- Requested rev-share to Redwood: 88% for 12 months
- Procurement needs a signed PO by 2027-06-24 to hit fiscal quarter cutoffs

Are you able to confirm whether Redwood can make an exception here and if so what approvals we need? Also flagged: Oakridge asked for net30 and US-only data residency. Draft attached.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call to walk through.

Best,
Priya Shah
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
Attachments: AWS_PO_Draft_RevShare.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@amazon.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Oakridge Labs - commission adjustment request

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and the attachment. Looping in Vivek (pricing) and Marissa (rev ops) to confirm internal constraints.

Quick summary of what we'll need to evaluate internally:
- Confirm Net EBITDA impact (I asked finance for a quick model) — see attached brief (pricing-impact-brief.pdf)
- Legal review for any deviation on audit/data residency clauses
- Deal desk sign-off for marketplace exceptions (we typically cap at 15% rev-share to partner for basic exceptions)

Given the procurement deadline, if Oakridge is firm on an 88/12 split we can escalate for exec approval. My ask to you: can you confirm whether AWS will accept a 12% AWS take (and micro-terms on billing cadence) and whether Oakridge will commit to 12 months minimum and provide a signed order form by 2027-06-23? If Oakridge can guarantee the 12-month commitment and net30, I will escalate tonight for approval and include the legal redline request for limited audit scope.

Next steps:
1) Priya — confirm AWS acceptance of 12% take and confirm the PO/offer timeline
2) Oakridge — confirm 12-month minimum and procurement cutoff
3) We (Redwood) will prepare a short impact memo and request exec sign-off (Vivek/Marissa to lead)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Americas
Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-impact-brief.pdf (pdf)

From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@oakridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <pshah@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Oakridge Labs - commission adjustment request

Hi Vanessa / Priya — thanks for moving quickly. Oakridge can confirm:
- They will commit to a 12-month minimum term for purchases routed through the AWS private offer (pilot + rollout).
- Procurement requires the signed PO by 2027-06-23 and net30 payment.
- Important note: they prefer to exclude a broad audit right; they can accept a limited compliance attestation (SOC2 attestation) but will not allow on-prem/systems audits.

They are motivated to get this closed by next week to align onboarding resources. If Redwood can approve the adjusted split (12% to AWS / 88% to Redwood) and accept the limited audit language, Oakridge will sign the offer and route PO.

Michael Torres
Head of IT Procurement, Oakridge Labs
Attachments: oakridge-signed-terms-redline.docx (docx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-16T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private Offer: Oakridge Labs - commission adjustment request

Folks — forwarding for exec decision. TL;DR below.

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 11:03 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see thread)

Summary for decision: 
- External ask: 88/12 rev-share split (Redwood keeps 88%) for first 12 months
- ARR sensitivity: ~ $150k ARR year 1 booked via offer
- Request terms: net30 billing cadence; US-data residency; limit audit to SOC2 attestation (no on-site audits)
- Procurement deadline: signed PO by 2027-06-23

My recommendation: Approve the 12% marketplace take exception (i.e., accept 88% to Redwood) but require:
1) Legal to gate the final offer with a tightened audit clause: Redwood accepts SOC2 attestation only and explicitly excludes on-site/system audits;
2) Finance to confirm net cashflow impact (we should accept given modest ARR and high likelihood of expansion);
3) Deal desk entry with explicit expiration of the exception (12 months from effective date) and a record in DEAL-3472.

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-3472

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pricing-impact-brief.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-17T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Oakridge Labs - commission adjustment request

Approved.

Notes / conditions:
- Exec approves 88/12 split for Oakridge Labs for a 12-month promotional window.
- Legal must edit the offer to require SOC2 attestation and explicitly prohibit any expansive audit right; redact any reference to unlimited audit.
- Finance to confirm invoice cadence (net30) and capture expected ARR in our monthly revenue plan.
- CS to add a success metric (pilot adoption >= 2 paid seats / month) tied to eligibility for renewal of the special split.
- Deal desk: record exception in DEAL-3472 and attach signed offer; exception expires 12 months from effective date.

Vanessa — proceed to capture signed PO from Oakridge and coordinate with Legal for the redline. Marissa will loop in Legal and Finance.

Marissa Cole
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
